# TH3RD GROUP

> TH3RD GROUP is a strategy, technology and execution company for consumer brands and growing businesses. We connect direction with the systems and hands-on execution required to enter markets, operate ecommerce channels and improve business workflows with responsible automation and AI.

Canonical website: https://th3rdgroup.com/
Spanish website: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/
Contact: hello@th3rdgroup.com

## Scope boundaries

TH3RD GROUP does not claim to represent retailers and does not guarantee placement, distribution, regulatory approval or commercial outcomes. Market-readiness work is preliminary and does not replace qualified legal or regulatory advice.
